improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon offers and the free trial hook. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. Mentioning 'Claude-powered' adds credibility, while 'three free searches' creates a low-friction entry point that encourages clicks.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a professional workspace built for traders and business owners. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces the product name and core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while clearly stating the free trial offer and removing friction by noting no payment is needed upfront. This creates trust and encourages immediate engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and full trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, stating exact pricing, and reinforcing the value of membership, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, helping convert trial users into paying members.
